pages.text: Your Stand has stats of its own:$(li)$(bold)Power$(): attack with it.$(li)$(bold)Speed$(): use its abilities.$(li)$(bold)Endurance$(): keep it summoned.$(li)$(bold)Protection$(): block with it.$(li)$(bold)Potential$(): spend its energy.

$(bold)Trust$() is the average of those five. It rises through $(bold)Dormant$(), $(bold)Partial$() and $(bold)Emerging$() to $(bold)Bonded$().$(br2)Some moves wait until your Stand trusts you, and each Bond Rank adds to its energy.
